note: c3: 魚浜町 / 浜町 / 本浜町 / 新浜町 / 栄町 edge, the raised fish-processing district. Read from Google Earth 3D (imagery 2026-03-11) in raw/ref/earth/c3 (the whole cell plus five 250 m sub-cells n1 n2 m1 m2 s1 with top and four 60-degree obliques each), checked against the GSI photo. Main fixes: the fish plants were 5-8 storey offices (up to 26 m) and are 1-3 storey plants (8-12 m) with solar roofs; the empty raised blocks are bare earth and dry weeds, not lawn; two demolished buildings; new builds. Round 2: flat-roof colours of the plants and sheds re-read from the Earth top pixels (they were 14-24 L* lighter than Earth).
